content:
Liam Park: FYI - increased 5xxs reported for APAC hosted endpoints starting ~13:07 UTC. Customer reports coming in. Investigating.
Samira Khan: Looking at gateway logs, seeing burst of token-refresh requests followed by 401s from auth backend. A few proxy pods show elevated CPU.
Ravi Patel: Im going to scale down the new auth-proxy revision and route traffic away from it. Preparing rollback.
eng-oncall-bot: alert: hosted-api.apac: 5xx-rate 7.9% over 5m.
Liam Park: Mitigation actions: 1) stop canary; 2) roll proxy back to previous stable; 3) enable token caching fallback for 10m. Proceeding.
deploy-bot: action: traffic-split update applied (service: auth-proxy) - canary -> 0%.
Samira Khan: After shifting traffic, 5xx rate falling to ~1.5% in ap-sg1. Latency stabilizing.
Ravi Patel: Rollback completed (rev:v2026.03.10 -> v2026.03.09). Patch queued to add exponential backoff to token refresh.
Liam Park: Notifying ops, CS, and status. Draft status: "APAC hosted inference experienced elevated 5xx errors due to an auth-proxy token-refresh loop introduced in a recent canary. Rollback completed; mitigation in place. No data exposure."
eng-oncall-bot: statuspage draft: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/def456 - visibility set to major/partial.
Samira Khan: Monitoring notes: kv-cache hitrate unchanged, per-route token errors concentrated to auth-proxy nodes with new build.
Ravi Patel: Follow-ups assigned: add canary auth synthetic test (owner: Samira), enforce client jitter and backoff (owner: Ravi), update runbook for auth-proxy scaling (owner: Liam).
Liam Park: Created postmortem ticket INF-4529: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4529 - will include timeline and mitigation steps.
Samira Khan: Sending DMs to top impacted customers and CS.
eng-oncall-bot: incident state: mitigated - monitoring for regressions.
Liam Park: Thanks all. Will update once postmortem is ready. :white_check_mark:
